HooksViewer.CatalogIntro: Every event discovered in core/ and plugins/: where it is posted, what it receives and which plugins listen to it. Use it to find the right hook when you build a Matomo plugin.
HooksViewer.ProductionWarning: Development tool: never keep HooksViewer activated on a production instance. It shows internal arguments and writes a log file on every request.
HooksViewer.LogFile: Every hook of every request is also written to %s.
HooksViewer.NoDescription: No description in the source code.
HooksViewer.DynamicHelp: This hook is listened to, but its name is built at runtime (like Controller.CoreHome.index), so it is not found in the source code.
HooksViewer.ListenExample: Listen to this hook in your plugin
HooksViewer.Rescanned: The hook catalog has been rebuilt.
